title: ‘Spider-Man: Brand New Day’ Leaks Online: Millions Watched Bootleg Before It Was Taken Down
content:
ByMatt Minton

mminton@variety.com

While Marvel fans are expected to turn out in droves to see “Spider-Man: Brand New Day” in theaters this weekend, a high-quality bootleg of the film leaked on X, with millions of people having viewed it.

Posted by an account named Fredrick Bryan at 6:05 a.m. PT, the leaked video reached 5.9 million accounts and counting, with over 143,000 people liking the post and 10,000 people resharing before it was taken down around 3:25 p.m. PT.

Several other X accounts also posted copies, though most didn’t last long on the platform. Studios typically send infringement notices to those posting unauthorized copies, though it can be difficult to keep ahead of the volume of posting for the most popular new films.

Sony had no comment.

“Brand New Day” is far from the first big-budget film to leak online. Last week, Christopher Nolan’s tentpole “The Odyssey”leaked on Xwith its own high-quality bootleg. It reached 2.1 million views within two and a half hours and was eventually taken down with a notice. The account itself was suspended as well.

Addressing “The Odyssey” leak, Universal issued a statement toVarietyon Sunday: “We became aware of the unauthorized posting of the film and immediately initiated takedown protocols. We take copyright infringement seriously and will pursue all appropriate remedies to protect our content and intellectual property rights.”

Regardless of the leak, “Brand New Day” is already doing exceptional business at the box office. It made arecord-breaking $72 millionin previews, including Tuesday early access screenings — the most of any movie in history. That placed it above “Avengers: Endgame,” which grossed $60 million in Thursday previews.

“Brand New Day” sees the return of Tom Holland as the famous web-slinger, with Emmy-winner Zendaya returning as MJ. The cast also includes Sadie Sink in a mystery role, Jon Bernthal and Jacob Batalon.
title_zh: 《蜘蛛人：全新的一天》(Spider-Man: Brand New Day) 網路洩漏：數百萬人觀看盜版影片後被下架
content_zh:
作者：馬特·敏頓(Matt Minton)

隨著漫威影迷預計將在本週末蜂擁而至觀看《蜘蛛人：全新的一天》(Spider-Man: Brand New Day)，一部高品質的盜版影片在X平台上洩漏，已經有數百萬人觀看。

這段影片由一個名為弗雷德里克·布萊恩(Fredrick Bryan)的帳號於太平洋時間早上6:05發布，洩漏的影片已經觸及590萬個帳號，並持續增加，超過143,000人按讚，10,000人轉發，直到太平洋時間下午3:25被刪除。

其他幾個X帳號也發布了該影片的副本，儘管大多數在平台上存活的時間不長。影業通常會向那些發布未經授權副本的人發送侵權通知，但對於最受歡迎的新片，保持對大量發布的監控是相當困難的。

索尼(Sony)未對此事發表評論。

《全新的一天》(Brand New Day)並不是第一部在網上洩漏的大預算電影。上週，克里斯多福·諾蘭(Christopher Nolan)的重磅影片《奧德賽》(The Odyssey)也在X上洩漏，並出現了高品質的盜版。該影片在兩個半小時內達到210萬次觀看，最終被刪除並發出通知。該帳號也被暫停。

針對《奧德賽》的洩漏，環球影業(Universal)於週日向《綜藝》(Variety)發表聲明：“我們已經注意到該影片的未經授權發布，並立即啟動了刪除程序。我們非常重視版權侵權問題，並將追求所有適當的補救措施來保護我們的內容和知識產權。”

儘管有洩漏事件，《全新的一天》(Brand New Day)在票房上已經表現出色。它在預映中創下了破紀錄的7200萬美元，包括週二的提前放映——這是歷史上任何電影的最高紀錄。這使它超越了《復仇者聯盟：終局之戰》(Avengers: Endgame)，後者在週四的預映中獲得了6000萬美元。

《全新的一天》(Brand New Day)中，湯姆·霍蘭德(Tom Holland)再次回歸飾演這位著名的蜘蛛俠，艾美獎得主辛迪亞(Zendaya)也回歸飾演MJ。演員陣容還包括薇薇安·辛克(Sadie Sink)的神秘角色、喬恩·伯恩薩爾(Jon Bernthal)和雅各·巴塔隆(Jacob Batalon)。
